papers.title: Rehabilitation and prevention of complications after total hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract: A comparative analysis of the structure and frequency of complications after total hip replacement (THR) and basic methods of prevention based on experience treating 303 patients with diseases and injuries of the hip joint. It is proved that a comprehensive system of rehabilitation of patients, which includes preoperative preparation, prevention of complications, operation planning and original methods of treatment, diagnostics and physiotherapy, for each stage of treatment, up to the final physiological and social rehabilitation, provides a significant reduction in the number of complications, achieving optimal outcomes of treatment and functional outcomes.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅讨论术后康复方案，未涉及任何生物力学建模、应力分析或种植体稳定性评估。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis; purely clinical rehabilitation.

summary_zh.method: 对比分析303例患者的综合康复系统效果。
summary_zh.result: 综合康复系统显著减少并发症并改善功能结局。
summary_zh.validation: 通过303例临床患者数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To analyze the structure and prevention methods of complications after total hip replacement.
summary_en.method: A comparative analysis of a comprehensive rehabilitation system applied to 303 patients with hip diseases and injuries.
summary_en.result: The comprehensive rehabilitation system significantly reduces complications and achieves optimal functional outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation using outcomes from 303 patients.
